name: Zero External CSS
rule: No CSS frameworks (Bootstrap, Tailwind) or external stylesheets allowed. All styling must use semantic HTML, inline attributes, or Canvas/SVG styling.

name: High-Contrast Dark Mode Only
rule: The interface must strictly operate in high-contrast dark theme (#121212 base) with neon accenting and no pure white backgrounds.

name: Mobile-Only Form Factor
rule: The application must be designed specifically for a mobile screen constraint (max-width: 420px) and operate comfortably one-handed.

name: Zero Scrollbars / 100vh Viewport
rule: The entire application must fit within 100vh without vertical or horizontal scrollbars. All secondary options must collapse or tab neatly.

name: Two-Click Maximum Rule
rule: Any primary task (creating, filtering, checking status) must be achievable in two clicks or fewer from the initial load screen.

name: Keyboard-Only Navigation
rule: The application must be 100% operable via keyboard controls (Tab, Enter, Space, Arrow keys) with visible focus outlines and no mouse dependency.

name: Pure Vanilla JavaScript
rule: Zero external libraries, CDNs, or frameworks (no jQuery, React, Lodash, or chart libs). Code must be authored in pure standard Web APIs.

name: Micro-Footprint (<100KB Total)
rule: The entire frontend bundle (HTML, CSS, JS, assets) must remain under 100KB uncompressed, prioritizing extreme code efficiency.

name: Offline-First Operation
rule: Once loaded, the application must function completely without internet connectivity. If remote resources fail, local fallbacks must seamlessly engage.

name: Zero Local Storage / Ephemeral State
rule: No localStorage, sessionStorage, or cookies allowed. All data must reside either in reactive runtime memory or in URL parameters/hashes.

name: URL Hash State Sync
rule: All user actions and filters must serialize into the window URL hash (`#state=...`) allowing any view to be shared and restored via URL.

name: Zero Text-Input Fields
rule: No `<input type='text'>` or `<textarea>` tags permitted. All input must be driven by range sliders, toggle buttons, dials, or presets.

name: Single View / No Modals
rule: No modal popups, dialog boxes, or multi-page routing. All details, previews, and feedback must expand seamlessly inline within the single view.

name: Multi-Modal Audio-Visual Feedback
rule: Every button click, state change, and status alert must produce both a visible micro-animation and an audible tone or synthetic voice cue.

name: Reversible Actions / 5-Step Undo
rule: The application must maintain an interactive history stack allowing users to undo and redo their last 5 state operations seamlessly.
